verdict.rationale: Rules that fire actions on email events are a fair question for an AI email client, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only on-demand MCP tools (modify labels, bulk archive/delete) and a founder description of built-in auto-categorization. Neither shows user-defined, event-triggered rules, so both are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
